name: Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A.
summary: Zaklady Azotowe Pulawy S.A. manufactures and sells fertilizer and chemical products worldwide. It provides nitrogen fertilizers under PULAN, PULAN MACRO, megAN 33,5, SALMAG, PULMIX, Saletrzak 27N, eNpluSTM, and PULREA name; urea under PULGRAN name; urea ammonium sulfate under the PULGRANS name; RSM, RSMOptima and RSMS, PULSAR and ammonium sulfate from the Flue Gas Desulfurisation Unit; nitrogen fertilizer solution with sulfur under PULASKA name; potassium nitrate, fertilizer-grade calcium nitrate, calcium nitrate with boron, and fertilizergrade liquid urea, and Azoplon.
